assertions.assertion: The member presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
There is a need to correlate arrhythmic events with hemodynamic status
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to evaluate for underlying rhythm disturbances
The service corresponds to CPT code 93247
The service is clinically appropriate given the diagnosed conditions I25.10 and I34.0
